items.scenePlan:
(this moment's place, time and action; obey the rules, brief, canon and style):
Primary subject: Alice, turning her head with a guarded look toward the Queen standing close behind her.
Action: Alice hastily covers her unkind remark with a polite word as the Queen passes, smiling.
Setting: The Queen's croquet-ground in a Wonderland garden with flower beds, a mushroom-edged lawn and hedges.
Secondary elements: The Cheshire Cat's grinning head hangs in the air beside Alice; flat card courtiers stand near the lawn; a flamingo and hedgehogs lie scattered on the ground.
Mood: Sly, tense and faintly comic, with a hint of danger.
Time of day: Warm, still afternoon with soft dappled golden daylight and a faint dreamlike haze.
Composition: Alice in the foreground at the left, the Queen approaching from behind her at right, the grinning Cat's head floating between them.

(this moment's place, time and action; obey the rules, brief, canon and style):
Primary subject: Roman soldiers in tunics and helmets, crouched in a group on the ground
Action: Dividing the clothing of the crucified man by casting lots, a soldier shaking dice in a cupped hand
Setting: A rocky hill outside Jerusalem with a stony road and a crude wooden cross
Secondary elements: Folded cloaks and garments spread on the dusty ground; the crucified figure raised above, seen from below and kept distant
Mood: Grim, weary and indifferent, with a heavy, solemn undertone
Time of day: Midday turning toward afternoon; hot still air with sky beginning to dim
Composition: Low viewpoint looking up at the cross, soldiers grouped in the lower foreground, figure above framed against the bright sky

(this moment's place, time and action; obey the rules, brief, canon and style):
Primary subject: Alice, turning her head with a guarded look toward the Queen standing close behind her.
Action: Alice hastily covers her unkind remark with a polite word as the Queen passes, smiling.
Setting: The Queen's croquet-ground in a Wonderland garden with flower beds, a mushroom-edged lawn and hedges.

(this moment's place, time and action; obey the rules, brief, canon and style):
Primary subject: Alice, a young Victorian girl in pinafore, holding a small bottle up to examine it
Action: She studies the paper label reading DRINK ME, considering whether to taste it.
Setting: A long low hall with a row of hanging lamps and a small glass table, a tiny locked door to the garden at one end.
Secondary elements: The small glass table with the bottle, a key on the table, the tiny door set low in the wall behind her.
Mood: Cautious, curious and quietly bewildered.
Time of day: Afternoon indoors, dry and still air, soft amber lamplight mixed with cool grey daylight from high windows.
Composition: Medium shot from the side, Alice at left centre with the bottle raised to eye level, table and tiny door visible to the right.

(this moment's place, time and action; obey the rules, brief, canon and style):
Primary subject: The White Rabbit at the witness stand, spectacles on, holding the folded paper open to read aloud.
Action: The Rabbit begins reading the verses while the court leans in to listen.
Setting: The Queen of Hearts' long courtroom with a raised bench and tall windows.
Secondary elements: The King seated on his throne, the Queen beside him, Alice standing nearby in her pinafore, the jury box of animal and bird figures, card courtiers lining the walls.
Mood: Stuffy, absurd expectancy with a gently bewildered undercurrent.
Time of day: Afternoon, warm dim candlelight mixing with grey daylight from the high windows.
Composition: Wide view from the back of the hall, the Rabbit at centre, the bench behind him, Alice and the jury arrayed on either side.

(this moment's place, time and action; obey the rules, brief, canon and style):
Primary subject: Daniel, a plain-cloaked prophet, standing upright with one hand raised in refusal.
Action: Daniel declines the king's rewards and turns to speak, offering to read the writing on the wall.
Setting: Royal palace of Babylon, a vast banquet hall with tall columns and glazed brick walls.
Secondary elements: Belshazzar seated on a throne in royal robes, nobles in embroidered tunics frozen at the feast tables, a golden cup on a low table, a faint eerie glow on the wall near the bright hand.
Mood: Tense, solemn and dignified, with quiet authority rising in the hushed hall.
Time of day: Night, lamplit feast hours, still windless air.
Composition: Daniel at left three-quarter view facing the seated king at right, the wall with its glow visible in the background between them.

(this moment's place, time and action; obey the rules, brief, canon and style):
Primary subject: Alice, in a Victorian pinafore dress, holding a flamingo under her arm with its neck half-straightened and its head turned up in puzzlement.
Action: Alice pauses mid-swing as the flamingo twists to look at her while the Queen of Hearts stamps forward, crimson-gowned, shouting.
Setting: The Queen's croquet-ground: a flat lawn of ridges and furrows, with a painted rose-bush and a tall arch formed by card soldiers bent double on their hands and feet.
Secondary elements: Card soldiers flat and oblong, painted like playing cards, arched over the lawn; hedgehogs unrolling and crawling away across the furrows; the Queen in a long crimson velvet gown with a golden crown, sceptre in hand, stamping in the middle distance.
Mood: Comic bewilderment with a rising note of unease.
Time of day: Afternoon, warm, still and dry, under flat even daylight with soft shadows.
Composition: Eye-level view across the lawn, Alice in the left foreground, the arch of card soldiers framing the centre, the Queen stamping at right mid-ground.

(this moment's place, time and action; obey the rules, brief, canon and style):
Primary subject: A row of weathered carved stone markers standing upright along the road, the first marker larger and set apart at the front.
Action: Stillness; the stones stand in a quiet line as villagers pass by without stopping, as if reading a family's inheritance in the landscape.
Setting: A Roman Judean village street of pale limestone houses, a plastered synagogue wall beside the road, and dry hills in haze beyond.
Secondary elements: A few villagers in undyed wool tunics and cloaks walking past at a distance, a Roman soldier in red-trimmed military dress near the synagogue wall, and a dusty path leading the eye down the line of stones.
Mood: Quiet, reverent and grounded, with a sense of lineage and continuity.
Time of day: Daytime, late morning, clear and dry with light haze over the hills.
Composition: Low eye-level view down the road, the row of stone markers receding toward the horizon, with the largest marker in the foreground left third.

(this moment's place, time and action; obey the rules, brief, canon and style):
Primary subject: The Hatter, rumpled and pale, clutching a teacup and bread-and-butter before the bench
Action: He nervously bites a large piece out of his teacup instead of the bread-and-butter, while the Queen stares at him through spectacles
Setting: A crowded Wonderland courtroom with a raised bench and a jury box, under a tall arched hall
Secondary elements: The King seated on the bench, the March Hare and Dormouse together at the side, jurors with slates in the box, and a flat playing-card courtier crowd lining the sides
Mood: Tense, bewildered and sharply absurd, with the Hatter's fear played for slapstick
Time of day: Indoors at a steady midday-like hour, warm and unchanging
Composition: Medium-wide view from the side of the court, the Hatter centred before the bench with the Queen's raised spectacles in view above him

(this moment's place, time and action; obey the rules, brief, canon and style):
Primary subject: Paul, standing still and facing a polished bronze mirror held at chest height
Action: He pauses, gazing into the dim reflection as if searching for a clearer image, while the believers look on.
Setting: Stone courtyard of a house-church in Corinth, with colonnades and arches and a marketplace visible beyond
Secondary elements: A small group of believers in plain tunics and cloaks gathered near the arches, faces turned toward Paul; an oil lamp on a ledge; scattered papyrus rolls, closed and unmarked.
Mood: Quiet, contemplative and humble, with a sense of longing for clearer sight.
Time of day: Late afternoon, sun lowering toward evening under clear, dry air with a faint dust haze.
Composition: Medium shot from slightly low angle, Paul centered in the foreground with the mirror raised, the believers arranged in a loose arc behind and the colonnade framing the scene.

(this moment's place, time and action; obey the rules, brief, canon and style):
Primary subject: Alice standing defiantly on the courtroom floor, chin lifted, facing the high dais.
Action: The King shuts his note-book in a flustered gesture while the Queen leans toward him and the jury waits.
Setting: A long Wonderland courtroom with a raised dais, a tall judge's bench and a crowded jury box.
Secondary elements: The King and Queen seated high on the dais in crowns and robes, flat oblong playing-card courtiers ranked along the benches, jurors in waistcoats and hats in the box.
Mood: Bewildered defiance tipping into comic unease, with the court's authority wobbling.
Time of day: Indoors during one unbroken session, warm candlelight from hanging lamps, no weather.
Composition: Alice in the lower foreground at the dais base, the King and Queen raised above her in the middle ground, the jury box to one side.

(this moment's place, time and action; obey the rules, brief, canon and style):
Primary subject: Radiant light and haze pouring through the city gate and filling the open square, with townsfolk turning toward it
Action: Golden radiance floods the gateway and spreads across the street, while people step forward to receive and gather it
Setting: Walled town with stone houses, market stalls and a broad open square before the great city gate
Secondary elements: Merchants in court robes and linen with open storage jars and chests, elders in cloaks, townsfolk in tunics, dust catching the light
Mood: Joyful, reverent and expectant, with a sense of abundance and dignity
Time of day: Bright midday in the busy hours, clear dry air with a light wind through the streets
Composition: Wide view from within the street looking toward the gate, light flowing from the gateway across the foreground with people spread through the scene
